references.text: Here we find the detailed regulations for the grain offering and drink offering that were to accompany burnt offerings of cattle, rams, and lambs—the same arrangement referred to by the phrase 'according to the regulation' in Num 29:21.
Describes the drink offering that was to accompany the daily burnt offering and establishes the pattern for drink offerings mentioned in Num 29:21.
Specifies the exact amounts of grain offering and drink offering for bulls, rams, and lambs at the New Moon festival—the same regulation referred to in Num 29:21.
A parallel verse from the same chapter that also describes grain offerings and drink offerings 'according to the regulation' for the sacrifices of the Feast of Tabernacles.
Repeats the same wording about grain offerings and drink offerings for bulls, rams, and lambs 'according to the regulation' on the seventh day of the Feast of Tabernacles.
Mentions grain offerings and drink offerings that accompany the burnt offering, illustrating the general practice referred to in Num 29:21.
